pages.text: $(o)A fallen hero bound to an altar among the graves, waiting to be called back.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() It fights in three moods and calls the dead to its side. Thin its servants before they surround you.$(br2)Its altar calls it. Come rested and ready.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Champion's Tarnished Crest$() counts for the quest book.
